title: rosa communis proles canina
intro: Rosa communis proles canina, commonly known as Dog Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. The health benefits of Dog Rose include its use in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and stomach ulcers, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Dog Rose include its ability to act as an astringent, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Dog Rose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
